diagnostics.message: `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.access_log` sets `block_public_policy = true` (and `restrict_public_buckets = true`) on the access-log bucket, but it only depends on `:resource.aws_s3_bucket.access_log`, not on `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.access_log_policy`. AWS S3 rejects `PutBucketPolicy` if the bucket's Public Access Block denies public policies, and Public Access Block settings are not retroactively safe for a policy applied concurrently — so the bucket policy must be written before the public access block is enabled. With no `depends_on` (and no attribute reference possible), Terraform may create the public access block first and the policy apply fails with AccessDenied. Add `depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy.access_log_policy]` to `aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.access_log`.
